canonical_project: Microsoft La Porte campus / Radius Industrial Park
aliases: Microsoft La Porte campus / Radius Industrial Park
Microsoft Radius Industrial Park data center

location.site_description: Initial Microsoft-owned site is bounded by Boyd Boulevard to the north and East 250 South to the south; proposed expansion area is east of the initial campus toward East State Road 4 and Stevens Road.

status_history.note: Baseline extraction carried no independently verified status.
Microsoft community materials state initial site preparation began in March 2026 and would continue through summer.
Regional/industry reports, citing Microsoft President Brad Smith, reported a June 17, 2026 groundbreaking for the La Porte data center campus.

actions.exact_result_status: IEDC announced Microsoft's planned $1 billion La Porte data center and a 35-year state data-center sales-tax credit for at least $1 billion of eligible investment; no local vote tally was published.
actions.access_caveat: Official state page accessible; it does not publish the city/county site-plan or permit packet.

actions.body: City of La Porte / La Porte Redevelopment Commission / La Porte Community School Board
actions.exact_result_status: City announced an updated agreement under which Microsoft will pay local property taxes in full; La Porte Redevelopment Commission will allocate 15% of this revenue to La Porte Community School Corporation for 20 years. City page states the agreement was approved that morning by the Redevelopment Commission and the school board.
actions.access_caveat: Official city news page; detailed agreement packet not reviewed.

actions.exact_result_status: Microsoft community meeting boards state the initial 489-acre site is zoned for datacenter development, initial site preparation began in March 2026, and phase-one construction is expected to complete the first datacenter building in early spring 2029, the second in mid-spring 2029, and the third in winter 2029; construction completion is not the same as operational availability.
actions.access_caveat: Company community-meeting PDF; conceptual site plan and subsequent build timing are explicitly not final.

actions.body: City of La Porte Common Council
actions.action_type: annexation, infrastructure agreement, land-sale resolution, zoning-introduction actions
actions.exact_result_status: Council minutes record unanimous adoption of Ordinance No. 6-2026 for East Annexation, unanimous approval of a Framework Infrastructure Development Agreement with Microsoft, and unanimous approval of Resolution R-12-2026 approving a purchase and sale agreement to Microsoft for approximately 119.5 acres at about $17.3 million. Minutes also record first reading/introduction of an ordinance to amend the zoning map for one parcel, with second/final reading scheduled for June 2, 2026.
actions.access_caveat: Official city minutes; June 2, 2026 final zoning minutes were not located during this refresh.

actions.exact_result_status: Regional and industry outlets reported that Microsoft broke ground on the La Porte data center campus on June 17, 2026, citing Microsoft President Brad Smith; reports describe phase one as six buildings on the 489-acre Radius Industrial Park site, with an eastward expansion proposed.
actions.access_caveat: Regional media report with Microsoft photo/source attribution; no separate City of La Porte groundbreaking press release was found.

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

contradictions.description: Cleanview lists 538 MW and 1,489 acres for the La Porte Data Center, but official City/IEDC/Microsoft sources reviewed here disclose investment, acreage/building counts, and schedules rather than a MW capacity. capacity_mw remains null pending official utility, permit, or company confirmation.
